issue.summary: In the chat window, when a user selects only part of a message's text and right-clicks > 'Copy', the clipboard receives the ENTIRE message text instead of the selected portion. This was found during QA testing of issues #1350/#1316 on 2026-09-01 (chat web, v1.6.7, Edge + Chrome).
steps: 2. Open any conversation (single or group chat) with a message containing long text
3. Select only PART of the message text (e.g. the first few characters) with the mouse
4. Right-click on the selected text and click 'Copy' in the context menu
5. Paste into any editor (Notepad, another chat input) and inspect the copied content
issue.expected: Only the selected portion of the text is copied to the clipboard.
issue.actual: The ENTIRE message text is copied, regardless of the selection range.
issue.environment: - **Platform / OS / Browser**: Web / v1.6.7 / Microsoft Edge, Chrome
